blurb: Alchemy Wellness offers individualized bodywork sessions incorporating various massage and somatic techniques tailored to the client's needs. They also provide off-the-table sessions to investigate and renegotiate invisible agreements shaping life patterns. Sessions include intake and assessment, with options for in-person or therapeutic massage delivered to your doorstep.
